{{Quote|And when we open the gate, we will have power beyond measure... The power of the elder gods!|Mother Zalem, to [[Vonya]]|<ref name="SWIE">''[[Star Wars: Infinity's End]]''</ref>}}
The '''elder gods''' were divine entities [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Zalem/Legends|Zalem]] of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] believed held the power of the [[Infinity Gate]]s of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Zalem claimed that the elder gods held power beyond measure, power that the [[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|Sisters]] could harness by opening the Infinity Gates.<ref name="SWIE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The elder gods were mentioned in passing in the [[Star Wars: Infinity's End|Infinity's End]] story arc of the [[Star Wars: Republic|''Republic'']] comic series. ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' established that Nightsister religion under [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] was centered around the [[Spirit (Nightsisters)|Spirits]], primarily the [[The Ones/Legends|Twin Deities]]&mdash;the [[Son/Legends|Fanged God]] and the [[Daughter/Legends|Winged Goddess]].
